lines.text: Today I'm in a blazer and glasses. And the whole video is brighter.
A look is an outfit of parts: hair and top, glasses and a clip.
Its colours can follow the theme, while my face stays the same.
A theme gives every scene its colours: backgrounds and surfaces, text and accents, and its fonts.
Scenes only use its tokens, so every scene works in every theme.
This episode sets both in one file. The other videos keep the project's defaults.
Looks and themes of your own go in the project's library folder.
That's looks and themes! The gallery shows them all, side by side. Mix and match them in your project!
